en.summary: Hurricane Isaias is moving through the Gulf toward the Florida Panhandle, where counties have issued evacuation orders ahead of forecasted dangerous conditions.

en.title: Trump says U.S. to get diesel from Russia, relaxing pressure on Moscow to ease prices before midterms
en.summary: The Trump administration will purchase diesel from Russia to address domestic prices ahead of midterm elections, marking a shift in longstanding U.S. pressure on Moscow.

stories.title: Trump Announces White House Inquiry Into Fed Governor Lisa Cook

en.title: Trump Announces White House Inquiry Into Fed Governor Lisa Cook
en.summary: President Trump announced that the White House would investigate unsubstantiated claims of mortgage fraud involving Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook and schedule a hearing for the following month.

stories.title: Trump Says He Will Import Russian Diesel Fuel Amid High Prices

en.title: Trump Says He Will Import Russian Diesel Fuel Amid High Prices
en.summary: President Trump announced that Russia has agreed to ship potentially millions of tons of diesel fuel in coming months, though the volumes would be relatively small compared to global demand.

stories.title: Trump announces Russia will release millions of tons of diesel to help with costs

en.title: Trump announces Russia will release millions of tons of diesel to help with costs
en.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin agreed to deliver 300,000 tons of diesel immediately and additional millions of tons over subsequent months.

en.title: Will social media platforms allow Fort Hood shooter's execution to be livestreamed?
en.summary: The Pentagon plans to livestream the firing-squad execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan, raising questions about whether social media companies will permit such content on their platforms.

stories.title: Trump forms committee to investigate Fed's Lisa Cook

en.title: Trump forms committee to investigate Fed's Lisa Cook
en.summary: President Trump established a committee to investigate allegations that Federal Reserve Board member Lisa Cook submitted false statements on mortgage documents, following the Supreme Court's rejection of his attempt to remove her.

en.title: Trump picks "loyal" Katie Zacharia as next White House press secretary
en.summary: President Trump has appointed Katie Zacharia as the next White House Press Secretary, expressing confidence in her ability to deliver results for the country.

en.summary: Vice President Vance expressed reluctance about watching a potential livestreamed execution of Fort Hood gunman Maj. Nidal Malik Hasan and questioned whether the Pentagon's planned public execution would proceed.

en.summary: President Trump announced easing of Russia sanctions and stated that Russian President Putin would immediately release hundreds of thousands of tons of diesel fuel to the global market.

en.summary: Prediction market Kalshi is investigating trades that accurately predicted Katie Zacharia's appointment as White House Press Secretary, despite her not being considered a leading candidate beforehand.
